item.title: Unforgetful is a new reminders app for people who can’t stop hitting snooze
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Unforgetful, the latest app from longtime indie developer Marco Arment, is designed to make reminders harder to ignore — or accidentally dismiss.

item.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file.

item.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: Meta released Glimmer this week, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run on their own hardware — a contrast to Muse Spark, the company’s more powerful model that stays locked behind its own APIs. The release landed alongside a letter from Mark Zuckerberg arguing AI should be “for everyone” rather than controlled by a handful of labs, but as Equity’s […]

item.title: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple is asking a federal judge to allow it to charge commissions of up to 15% on purchases made through external links in iOS apps.

item.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: The idea that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows may be a misconception, according to French startup Kog.

item.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

item.title: US courts will start publishing how often the government uses spyware
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts told TechCrunch that it will start disclosing how many times judges authorized the use of spyware to wiretap suspected criminals.

item.title: Uber and Pony.ai plan to bring 2,000 robotaxis to Europe
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The partnership is expanding beyond the initial market of Zagreb, Croatia to four additional European cities.

item.title: Investors sue Selena Gomez alleging fraud tied to her mental health startup
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The plaintiffs say they invested nearly $1.2 million in the company, and are accusing Gomez of failing to build and market the startup.

item.title: Flock says its new tool will help identify police abuse, but hasn’t explained how it works
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: The surveillance company announced it's making a tool called "Audit Assistance" mandatory for all customers, claiming it's already helped catch abuse. But the company has yet to explain how the tool works in detail, raising questions about its effectiveness.

item.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Apple now sends out push notifications to iPhone lock screens when the company identifies government spyware targeting someone's devices.

item.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.

item.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: AI is expensive, Ali Ghodsi tells TechCrunch. With so many investors wanting into his latest round, he said yes to more than planned.

item.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is launching a preview of a sped up version of its latest, most powerful model, in an effort to court enterprise users.

item.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies as part of this deal.

item.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising new questions about whether today’s safety tests capture the risks of multi-agent systems.

item.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI has replaced chief revenue officer Denise Dresser after just nine months on the job, tapping Wiz president and chief operating officer Dali Rajic to take on frontier lab's top sales job.

item.title: Ford on track to complete $2B factory overhaul for Fathom EV truck
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Ford expects to begin prototype builds of the Fathom EV in the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: X open sources its ranking algorithm, letting users see if they’ve been ‘shadowbanned’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: X is expanding the open source code behind its 'For You' feed and launching new transparency tools that show users when its ranking systems have affected their accounts or posts.

item.title: Instagram introduces a redesigned wordmark
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The social media giant says it was time for a sharper and more modern look after a decade.
